webcams.name: Yosemite Falls
webcams.shows: Upper Yosemite Fall, the top tier of Yosemite Falls. The provider notes that flow peaks with early-summer snowmelt.
caveats: Guide 51.8 says the fall is usually dry from late summer into autumn.

webcams.name: Half Dome
webcams.shows: Half Dome's sheer face seen across the Valley floor; animals sometimes cross the frame.
webcams.origin: Ahwahnee Meadow, just east of Yosemite Village

webcams.name: El Capitan
webcams.shows: A Valley panorama with El Capitan on the left and Half Dome far off.
webcams.origin: a dome near the Wawona Tunnel (NPS)
caveats: The camera is not on El Capitan.

webcams.name: Merced River at Happy Isles
webcams.credit: U.S. Geological Survey, listed on NPS.gov
webcams.shows: The Merced River passing the USGS Happy Isles gauging station in the east Valley.
caveats: River readings in this app come from the Pohono Bridge gauge, not Happy Isles.

webcams.name: Wawona Dome
webcams.credit: Yosemite Conservancy with Yosemite Cabins and Vacation Home Rentals at The Redwoods
webcams.shows: Wawona Dome rising over the Wawona basin in the south of the park.
webcams.regionBasis: Conservancy page: Wawona basin, Wawona Dome pictured

webcams.name: Badger Pass Ski Area
webcams.shows: The ski area on Glacier Point Road; NPS offers it for checking conditions and activity.
caveats: A live picture does not mean the ski area or Glacier Point Road is open.
The time stamped on the image has not been verified.
webcams.regionBasis: NPS: camera at the Badger Pass Ski Area

webcams.name: High Sierra
webcams.shows: Half Dome with the high country behind it: Clouds Rest, Tenaya Peak and Cathedral Peak.
webcams.origin: about 8,000 ft (NPS); exact site not stated
caveats: A distant view that says nothing about Tioga Road or Tuolumne Meadows conditions.

webcams.name: Tuolumne Meadows
webcams.shows: Across the high country toward Fairview Dome.
webcams.season: NPS: in service approximately June through September
webcams.regionBasis: NPS: camera at the Tuolumne Meadows Store

webcams.name: Turtleback Dome air quality
webcams.shows: South-west toward the foothills, alongside the page's air-quality and weather readings.
webcams.season: NPS: operates in summer only; no winter access or power
caveats: Haze in a picture is not a measured air-quality value.

webcams.name: Yosemite West 1
webcams.shows: The current view and recent frames from a wildfire-detection camera.
webcams.season: Provider: some cameras switch to a power-saving winter mode
caveats: Responders aim it; on October 5 it pointed north-west, away from the park.

webcams.name: Yosemite West 2
webcams.shows: A second detection camera at the same site, aimed independently.
webcams.season: Provider: some cameras switch to a power-saving winter mode
caveats: Responders aim it; on October 5 it pointed west-north-west, away from the park.

webcams.name: ALERTCalifornia camera map
webcams.shows: The provider's map of wildfire cameras around Yosemite, including Signal Peak, Miami Peak and Cherry Lake Road, plus June Mountain to the east (pan east to find it). The cameras reviewed near Yosemite all stand outside the park boundary.

providerNotes.conservancy: Yosemite Conservancy notes its remote cameras occasionally have unplanned outages, and asks anyone featuring them to accept its webcam usage agreement.
providerNotes.nps: NPS camera pages show an Active or Inactive status; active pages reload the image every 60 seconds.
providerNotes.nps-air: The NPS air page pairs the picture with air and weather readings; each carries its own time.
providerNotes.alertca: ALERTCalifornia imagery is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, credited “ALERTCalifornia | UC San Diego”. Trained responders aim these cameras; a camera pointed at smoke is not an evacuation order.
